epochs: Pioneer settlement
Narrow compacted EARTH road, sparse low Korean straw-thatched timber huts with rough-stone bases, simple fences, no developed city infrastructure.

Primitive Gwangan bay crossing, two modest braced timber gateways on timber/stone piers, low timber decking over water; hills and bay beside the dirt road. A period precursor of Gwangan Bridge, not a modern suspension bridge.

Small open-air communal performance courtyard with one broad asymmetric thatched timber canopy beside the road: the humble cultural ancestor of Cinema Center. Modest scale, timber posts, no modern concrete cone.
Walled village
Broad rutted DIRT road, Korean STRAW-THATCHED houses with earth walls and wooden gate, one tiled civic building, no asphalt,glass towers,modern cars or LEDs.
Period Gwangan coastal crossing with paired stone-and-timber gate towers, stone piers and low timber spans across bay, approached naturally by village dirt road. No modern steel suspension bridge.
Low supported timber theatre pavilion with broad asymmetric tiled roof and stepped stone courtyard, thatched houses on dirt road. Cultural ancestor of Cinema Center; no giant modern metal roof.
Traditional market town
Worn cobblestone mixed with earth road, distinct Korean timber and tile-roof market houses, a few fabric awnings and craft stalls, civic tower, no electricity or modern steel.

Larger Gwangan coastal stone-and-timber bridge with paired stone gateway towers, robust stone piers and carefully joined wooden span, road leads through harbour market towards bridge. Bay clearly visible.

Prosperous Korean timber-and-tile public theatre, broad asymmetric roof on readable timber trusses, stone stepped performance courtyard beside market road; a richer and larger Cinema Center precursor than village.
Industrial brick city
Gravel and patchy cobblestone working ROAD between distinct red/brown brick warehouses, riveted iron and sawtooth roofs, timber shopfronts, sober historical industrial detail; no futuristic glass.
Riveted iron coastal TRUSS bridge across Gwangalli bay with two paired iron towers and substantial masonry piers; recognisable period evolution of Gwangan crossing. Its approach joins the street.

Brick public performance hall with a broad asymmetric riveted iron-truss roof and stepped plaza beside the industrial road; historical industrial Cinema Center precursor. Every beam has a plausible support.
Early modern civic city

Early asphalt street, restrained white lane paint,3-6-storey stone/brick civic buildings, art-deco and early reinforced concrete, simple electric streetlamps and mature trees, no smart/future technology.
Early engineered Gwangan suspension crossing with twin masonry pylons and modest steel cables over bay, ordinary continuous deck and civic road approach. Early-modern materials and scale.
Early-modern civic cinema, broad LOW CANTILEVER canopy, art-deco stone and early-concrete supports, stepped forecourt, physically believable predecessor of Cinema Center, no futuristic LED mesh roof.
Present-day modern city

Realistic asphalt lanes, separate tram lane, ordinary6-16storey Korean offices/apartments of diverse designs, urban trees, standard lamps and very few proportionate vehicles far ahead. No sci-fi structures.
Recognisable present GWANGAN BRIDGE: twin steel suspension pylons, consistent cables, horizontal road deck across bay. View FROM coastal driving lane toward approach, not a side-on beach postcard.

Recognisable BUSAN CINEMA CENTER beside road ahead-right: huge asymmetric cantilever BIG ROOF, curved DOUBLE-CONE support and stepped open-air auditorium. Driving road stays OUTSIDE its plaza, not standing underneath the roof. Distinct modern Centum mixed buildings.
Solar research district

Solar research campus around real road, LOW/MIDRISE laboratories and research buildings, credible photovoltaic roof canopies, aluminium/timber/concrete facades and green courtyards. No huge future towers.
Gwangan twin-pylon suspension crossing with restrained solar service canopies and electric transit, continuous deck/cable load paths and believable anchorages, bay beside road.
Solar-upgraded Cinema Center with recognisable asymmetric Big Roof and double-cone mass, credible photovoltaic roof skin and connected LOW research campuses. Seen from the actual road, not in plaza.
Smart traffic hub

Well organised road with dedicated electric-shuttle lane, coherent tram interchange, discreet sensor poles and bus shelters, safe separated crossings and mixed midrise smart buildings, no holographic signs.
Smart Gwangan twin-pylon bridge, integrated connected tram/shuttle approach, complete credible piers,cables,decks, discreet road infrastructure not LED spectacle. Distinct Gwangalli coastline.

Smart Cinema Center civic transit hub, asymmetric cantilever Big Roof,double-cone support,outdoor auditorium, connected ground tram stop with separated road and boarding forecourt. View stays in driving lane.
Ecological waterfront city

Road with actual drivable asphalt centre, permeable edges, lush rain gardens and restored shoreline/water-sensitive canal, diverse green terraced eco-buildings, sustainable timber/concrete. No forest blocking road.
Ecological evolution of GWANGAN twin-suspension-pylon bridge and continuous deck over bay, terraced planted approach and separate coastal park edges. Not a generic arch footbridge.

Ecological Cinema Center with recognisable asymmetric Big Roof and curved double-cone forms, planted outdoor auditorium edges, living terraces and water-sensitive canal/landscape beside road. Contemporary-plus, not advanced flying city.
Hyperconnected elevated links

Ground-level advanced ROAD with discrete autonomous shuttles far away, two engineering-plausible elevated pedestrian links and raised transit connection on COMPLETE supports, mixed terraced buildings, no floating bridge. Camera remains on road below.

Advanced Gwangan twin-pylon bridge with integrated coherent elevated rail deck and connected pedestrian gallery, same continuous coastal crossing and credible anchorages/pylons. Layered transport approach joins street.

Connected Cinema Center with recognisable asymmetric cantilever Big Roof,double-cone form, COMPLETE skywalk connections to cultural buildings and a coherent raised tram station. Road below, film complex ahead-right.
Vertical garden high-tech city

Advanced ground boulevard among DISTINCT engineered stepped high-rises with vertical gardens, double-skin facades and roof terraces, quiet transit, diverse tower silhouettes, human-scale ground floor. Not cloned towers or an abstract forest of glass.

High-tech Gwangan twin-pylon suspension bridge with refined carbon/mineral structural members and planted multilevel approach, realistic cable/deck anchors, integrated transport. Recognisable evolved coastal crossing at middle distance.

High-tech Cinema Center among terraced vertical-garden towers, asymmetric Big Roof and double-cone support reinterpreted with fine real structural ribs,living terraces, complete skywalks. Identifiable evolving film complex, not generic UFO.

Refined FUTURE ROAD below camera, pale textured mineral composite surface with FLUSH discreet guidance, diverse advanced towers with engineered exoskeletons, curved laminated glass and mature vertical gardens. Elevated rail on real columns, no flying cars or neon.

Unmistakable ADVANCED FUTURE GWANGAN BRIDGE with two elegant tall paired suspension pylons, precise consistent cable fans and CONTINUOUS decks crossing bay, extra rail deck and planted LANDWARD approach. Ceramic-white/carbon materials, credible anchors. Entire foreground road and future waterfront share its perspective and natural daylight. NOT generic white arch or pasted bridge photograph.

Layered ceramic/composite photovoltaics, resolved supporting ribs, gardens and connected skywalks to distinct future towers. All physically unified with foreground future driving lane. No UFO/pasted roof photograph.
